restrictions: Two distinct 64-byte messages M(x), M(y). W0..W7 are the fixed prefix in proof Section 1; W8=y0, W9=y1; W10..W15 add the fixed offsets dbce7a42, aaf3823d, 8d41a28c, 7f214e02, 6423f959, 3e640e8c. The target uses the standard IV, exactly 52 steps on both padded blocks, feed-forward, and all 256 output bits.

The walk is g(x)=walkB(state_52(M(x))) XOR q with published q=03dd97725511b6448a6eb64133b582c98dfe57b88e8b9c487febef1ec217239f. The output registers already hold g. A collision of g implies equal complete digests.

Classical 256-bit word RAM under collision-frontier-v5, reference_operation_cost=3904. The machine has 1024 registers. Body records cost five code bytes and one operation; other instructions cost 36 bytes.
Preprocessing is 462181912032689987 operations and includes the wasm emitter plus the complete 1641-candidate offset and selector search envelopes. preprocessing_log2 rounds upward to 46.75051.
Peak memory is 1048575 bytes; setup peaks at 724162 bytes. Every table and code field fits its declared width.

The normative embedded C source has SHA-256 310d1c19490d2b00cd015b4476367aa4ed58de92120b053824daf595520273c4; stripped wasm SHA-256 55849627900db2a8e5187d78f2b8942c019310c88eb5ca6101c558de6383b4a2; emitted SLP SHA-256 de09f4fee2c0922e88298be60d9147a57f8db0b38b8ea1ccae09e2d1c635a7e9. The organizer executes the packaged Python byte-exact mirror; wasm accounting is participant-run.
For a uniformly random function, the bounded-restart calculation in proof Section 2 gives P_F at least 0.390000001000. H1 is the only score-critical premise and is declared, not proved.

heuristics.statement: The fixed walk succeeds at least as often as the exact bounded attempt against a lazy-sampled uniformly random 256-bit function. Fresh outputs retain collision hazard 2^-256, the first-collision law of a random mapping, independent DP density, and the same hazard after conditioning on the adaptive history.
heuristics.scope: The sha256-r52-prefix-v1 target, the 64-byte message family in proof Section 1, about 2^128 evaluations, and 256 simultaneous trails.
heuristics.extrapolation: The experiments check program correctness at width 16 and full-width projections, and compare fixed width-20 and width-22 projections with shared-function random-mapping ensembles. The fourfold state-space change checks persistence only. Extrapolation to the full attempt is by H1 only.
heuristics.limitations: H1 is a model premise about one fixed function, not a theorem. The experiments do not observe full-width collisions or estimate the claimed probability.
